name: Meeyan Ella Waterfall
description: Meeyan Ella is a scenic waterfall located near Ihalakotte Railway Station in the Kegalle District. The waterfall is connected with the surrounding Alagalla mountain landscape and has historical importance because of modifications made during the construction of the Colombo–Kandy railway line. Its rocky setting, flowing water and surrounding greenery make it attractive to nature lovers and photographers.

name: Ambuluwawa Biodiversity Complex
description: Ambuluwawa Biodiversity Complex is a mountain-top biodiversity and multi-religious attraction near Gampola. It is best known for its distinctive white spiral tower, landscaped surroundings and panoramic views across the central highlands. The complex combines natural scenery, cultural diversity, religious harmony and an adventurous tower-climbing experience.

location.address: Ambuluwawa Biodiversity Complex, Ambuluwawa ICC Road, Gampola 20500, Sri Lanka

openingHours.note: The attraction is normally open throughout the year. Opening times and access conditions may change, so verify current information before travelling.

travelInformation: Visitors using public transport can first travel to Gampola. From Gampola town, the Ambuluwawa entrance can be reached by tuk-tuk or another local transport option. The journey from Gampola to the entrance is approximately 5.6 km. The route continues uphill towards the biodiversity complex.

name: Saradiyel Village
description: Saradiyel Village is a cultural and educational attraction located at the foothills of Uthuwankanda near Mawanella. The village uses life-sized figures, structures and exhibits to present important events from the life of Sura Saradiyel and the social conditions of colonial-era Sri Lanka. It provides visitors with an engaging way to learn about regional history, culture and folklore.

name: Niloluwa Ancient Bridge
description: Niloluwa Ancient Bridge is a historic steel bridge crossing the Gurugoda Oya in Niloluwa village, Kegalle District. The bridge was manufactured at the Government Factory and constructed during the British colonial period. Its metal structure and riverside setting make it an important example of the region’s historical engineering heritage.

description: Dewanagala Rajamaha Viharaya is an ancient Buddhist temple situated on a large rock near Mawanella in the Kegalle District. Its elevated setting also provides views of the surrounding landscape.

name: Bathalegala (Bible Rock)
description: Bathalegala (Bible Rock) is one of the most iconic mountains in the Aranayake area, known for its distinctive rock formation that resembles an open Bible. It is a popular hiking destination offering panoramic views of the surrounding hills, forests, and villages. Visitors can enjoy nature, photography, trekking, and a peaceful atmosphere. A small Buddhist temple located near the summit adds cultural and religious significance to the site, making it attractive to both hikers and pilgrims.
